hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s\n' "$CMD" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|(]|&&|\|\|)[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+(commit|push)([[:space:]]|$)'; then BR=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BR" = "main" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: this project never commits or pushes directly to main. Create a branch (git checkout -b <name>), commit there, push it, and open a PR. See AGENTS.md." >&2; exit 2; fi; if printf '%s\n' "$CMD" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|(]|&&|\|\|)[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+commit([[:space:]]|$)'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This project requires an explicit instruction from the user before committing. Approve only if you actually asked for this commit. See AGENTS.md."}}'; exit 0; fi; fi; exit 0
